announcements.title: Late Submission Policy — Final Reminder
announcements.content: Dr. Webb has reiterated: late submissions receive a 25% deduction per day. After 4 days, the submission is not accepted at all. No exceptions, no extensions unless medical documentation is provided.

announcements.title: Kevin's Office Hours Update
announcements.content: Kevin Park's office hours have moved to Thursdays 2–4 PM in CS Building Room 203. He will NOT be answering emails during grading week. He is very clear about this.

announcements.title: Academic Integrity Reminder — MOSS Detection Active
announcements.content: The CS Department will use MOSS plagiarism detection on all code submissions this semester. Both the copier and the student who shared code will face academic integrity violations.

announcements.title: Tutoring Center Extended Hours
announcements.content: The CS tutoring center is open until midnight during the week before midterms. Kevin recommends using it instead of emailing him at 2 AM.
